spec2def(olecli32.dll olecli32.spec)

# olecli32.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/olecli32-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
add_library(olecli32_shims OBJECT olecli_main.c)
target_link_libraries(olecli32_shims PRIVATE wine libole32 libgdi32 libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
set_wine_module(olecli32_shims)
add_cargo_module(olecli32 olecli32-cargo olecli32.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS olecli32_shims psdk)
